text:
[Council File 14-0455-S10]
Board of Recreation and Park Commissioners report relative to authorizing the Department of Recreation and Parks (RAP) to submit a Summer Food Service Program 2025-2026 grant application to the California Department of Education and accept the grant award for the RAP Summer Lunch Program.
(This item is referred to the Arts, Parks, Libraries, and Community Enrichment Committee and Budget and Finance Committee.)
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Yes
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For:
Mid City West Neighborhood Council

outcome.text: Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Sep 9, 2026); Council action final
